title: The Wrong Group
question: 把今天“路线走错 -> 期待落空 -> 在这段时间里发生变化 -> 找可信成年人帮忙 -> 安全回到队伍”的表达，放进 supervised museum trip 场景：用 word bank 补完整 5 个空。
example_answer: During a supervised museum trip, I followed the wrong group. In the meantime, my class had moved on to another entrance. The bus did not take me where I hoped it would. I asked a museum staff member for help, and I was sent back to my group safely. I learned not to evade school rules.
word_bank: asked a museum staff member for help
was sent back to my group safely
